titol: this is a networking data visualization ;-)
text: “This is a networking data visualization ;-)” is a performative action that experiments with the conventions of networking in the art world, adding itself to the interactions that already take place at a space like an exhibition opening.

Through a labelling system dispensed by myself –presenting myself as a walking information and resource point– the roles, availabilities and capitals at play during these interactions are made visible, generating a minimal but uncomfortable displacement.
As part of Unfunny_Curator at the exhibition Tramas imaginarias.
